fusions.name: Cleave the Rank
fusions.desc: Swings the head at the full length of the haft through a cone 4 tiles long. It deals 26 damage to everything in it, ignores armour and leaves each target [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hooked Beard
fusions.desc: A weapon strike with the beard of the axe head that deals 4 damage, leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Foot of the Haft
fusions.desc: You slide both hands to the foot of the haft. Your critical damage rises by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Swing Carries On
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, the head keeps its arc and your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
